system-threading-lock.title: Use the dedicated System.Threading.Lock type
system-threading-lock.short: Express mutual exclusion with a synchronization-specific type
system-threading-lock.summary: Lock is a type dedicated to synchronization and works directly with the lock statement.
system-threading-lock.why: It makes synchronization intent explicit instead of using an arbitrary object as a monitor.
system-threading-lock.tips: Keep critical sections short and use an async-aware mechanism when waiting must cross await.

dictionary-alternate-lookup.title: Look up Dictionary entries with alternate key representations
dictionary-alternate-lookup.short: Query with spans without allocating a normal key
dictionary-alternate-lookup.summary: With a compatible comparer, Dictionary AlternateLookup can query using an alternate key representation such as ReadOnlySpan<char>.
dictionary-alternate-lookup.why: Parsers can avoid creating a string solely to perform a dictionary lookup.
dictionary-alternate-lookup.tips: Alternate key support depends on the comparer; prefer normal dictionary APIs unless allocation pressure justifies it.

interlocked-and-or.title: Update shared bit flags atomically with Interlocked.And and Or
interlocked-and-or.short: Change bits in one shared integer without a lock
interlocked-and-or.summary: Interlocked.And and Interlocked.Or apply atomic bitwise updates to shared integer storage.
interlocked-and-or.why: They avoid read-modify-write races when several threads update flags in the same value.
interlocked-and-or.tips: Use a lock when an invariant spans multiple values rather than forcing a complex lock-free design.

regex-count.title: Count regex matches directly with Regex.Count
regex-count.short: Get only the number of matches without enumerating Match objects
regex-count.summary: Regex.Count directly returns how many matches a pattern has in an input.
regex-count.why: When match contents are irrelevant, it states the goal more clearly than Matches(...).Count.
regex-count.tips: For complex patterns on external input, still consider a timeout or NonBacktracking.

jsonschema-exporter.title: Generate JSON Schema from .NET types with JsonSchemaExporter
jsonschema-exporter.short: Expose System.Text.Json type information as a schema
jsonschema-exporter.summary: GetJsonSchemaAsNode uses JsonSerializerOptions type information to produce a JSON Schema representation as JsonNode.
jsonschema-exporter.why: API documentation and validation schemas can start from serialization metadata close to the actual wire model.
jsonschema-exporter.tips: Review requiredness and domain-specific constraints before publishing generated output as a contract.
